title: Sparkly laptop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='screenGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fe6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3fa9d9'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='baseGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c9d3e0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8f9db3'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- laptop screen lid -->
  <rect x='22' y='20' width='56' height='40' rx='4' fill='#aab6c8'/>
  <rect x='22' y='20' width='56' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c9d3e0'/>
  <rect x='26' y='24' width='48' height='32' rx='2' fill='url(#screenGrad)'/>
  <!-- content on screen -->
  <rect x='31' y='30' width='20' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='31' y='37' width='34' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e6f7ff'/>
  <rect x='31' y='44' width='26' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e6f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='51' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- laptop base -->
  <rect x='16' y='60' width='68' height='9' rx='3' fill='url(#baseGrad)'/>
  <rect x='16' y='60' width='68' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e0e7f0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='63' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6f7d93'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <!-- top left sparkle -->
    <path d='M12 14 L14 20 L20 22 L14 24 L12 30 L10 24 L4 22 L10 20 Z'/>
    <!-- top right sparkle -->
    <path d='M86 10 L87.5 15 L92.5 16.5 L87.5 18 L86 23 L84.5 18 L79.5 16.5 L84.5 15 Z'/>
    <!-- small top right -->
    <path d='M92 30 L93 33 L96 34 L93 35 L92 38 L91 35 L88 34 L91 33 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#8ff0ff'>
    <!-- bottom left sparkle -->
    <path d='M10 76 L11.5 80.5 L16 82 L11.5 83.5 L10 88 L8.5 83.5 L4 82 L8.5 80.5 Z'/>
    <!-- far left small -->
    <path d='M16 44 L17 47 L20 48 L17 49 L16 52 L15 49 L12 48 L15 47 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffb3e6'>
    <!-- bottom right sparkle -->
    <path d='M88 68 L89.5 72.5 L94 74 L89.5 75.5 L88 80 L86.5 75.5 L82 74 L86.5 72.5 Z'/>
    <!-- right small -->
    <path d='M94 50 L95 53 L98 54 L95 55 L94 58 L93 55 L90 54 L93 53 Z'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='72' cy='16' r='1.8' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='88' r='1.8' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='86' r='1.5' fill='#ffb3e6'/>
</svg>
